The logo: the words as an extension of the cards

Holger, 27 Sep: 12f.3, 1a and 12a stay, and 12a.3 is interesting because it follows the flow of the cards. Could World of sit above Card Games on the same line, so the text feels like an extension of the cards? Seven versions of that in the 12a family, and the keepers as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “12a.6”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

1a Bolder World of

GLCA SemiBold on the small line over Medium on the big one. Kept as it is.

1a

Bolder World of

The small line in GLCA SemiBold

World of a weight up, so the small line holds its own against Card Games.

On the bar: 157 px wide (today 170), the big line’s capitals 14 px tall, the small line’s 8 px. On a phone: 118 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/01a-bolder.svg

12a Bowl, and the words as an extension of the cards

Card Games curving down under World of. 12a.3 turned the big line four degrees so it falls away from the front card’s corner and follows the cards’ flow. Now World of goes on the same line: bowed and turned with Card Games, turned only, steeper, from the card’s corner, with the bolder small line, and as a turned seal with 12f.3’s arc.

12a

Bowl

Card Games curves down, World of stays straight

The big line dips like a smile under a straight small line.

On the bar: 144 px wide (today 170), the big line’s capitals 12 px tall, the small line’s 6 px. On a phone: 108 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/12a-bowl.svg
12a.3

Falling from the card

The bowl turned four degrees, World of straight

The big line starts up by the front card’s corner and falls away to the right, then rises: the card’s slanted edge runs on into the words.

On the bar: 132 px wide (today 170), the big line’s capitals 11 px tall, the small line’s 6 px. On a phone: 99 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/12a3-falling.svg
12a.6

World of on the same line

Both lines bowed and turned four degrees

World of takes the same curve and the same turn as Card Games, so the two lines run as one band falling away from the cards.

On the bar: 126 px wide (today 170), the big line’s capitals 10 px tall, the small line’s 5 px. On a phone: 95 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/12a6-same-line.svg
12a.7

World of turned, not bowed

World of straight but turned with Card Games

The small line keeps its straight baseline and only takes the four-degree turn, so it sits like a label along the same slant.

Steeper still

Both lines at eight degrees

Every row is a file: logo-lab-out/12-arc.svg, 10-rules.svg and so on, with a -white copy for dark grounds. The type is outlined, so they need no font. The switch for 40px shows what the bar could draw if the logo were allowed more of its 56px.
